admission.justification: Overwriting an original verdict or reusing a tooling check as measurement would erase the instrument-error history and bias results.

applicability: Actor-free census and regrade of retained Codex or Hermes attempts.
conditions: Census freezes the selected attempt population, producer sources and exact package identity.
Execution rechecks source currency and binding, appends mode-specific results, and preserves original attempts/verdicts.
Tooling mode cannot replace a measurement result; stalled or semantic-unknown outcomes are reported without opportunistic retry.
exclusions: Appending later arrivals to an already frozen census.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Regrading freezes a deterministic census manifest and appends new actor-free results keyed by mode and actual package identity without overwriting earlier evidence.
